data.name: Nusaybah
data.gender_notes: Nusaybah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Nusaybah is the name of a brave and loyal companion of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him). She is known for her bravery and courage in the battles of Islam. The name Nusaybah carries the meaning “Brave Companion” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nusaybah usually hope their child will grow to embody brave companion and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of courage and loyalty in the face of adversity.
data.etymology: Nusaybah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Brave Companion.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nusaybah total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: نسيمة
in_arabic.meaning: اسم يعني بالنسيم الخفيف و اللطيف
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم نسيمة هو من الأسماء العربية التي تعني بالنسيم الخفيف و اللطيف، و هو مشتق من كلمة النسيم التي تشير إلى الهواء الناعم و الرقيق. و يعتبر هذا الاسم من الأسماء الجميلة و الرقيقة التي تطلق على الإناث في العالم العربي.

in_urdu.name: نسیمہ
in_urdu.meaning: نسیمہ نام کا مطلب ہے ہلکا سا نسيم
in_urdu.long_meaning: نسیمہ ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے ہلکا سا نسيم یا نرم ہوا۔ یہ نام عربی زبان میں نسيم سے ماخوذ ہے، جو نرم اور ہلکی ہوا کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔ جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمان معاشرے میں، یہ نام اپنی خوبصورتی اور رقت کے لئے مقبول ہے۔

in_hindi.name: नसीमा
in_hindi.meaning: नसीमा नाम का अर्थ है सुगंधित हवा
in_hindi.long_meaning: नसीमा एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है सुगंधित हवा या मृदुल वायु। यह नाम अरबी भाषा में نسيم से लिया गया है, जो हल्की और कोमल हवा को दर्शाता है। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम अपनी सुंदरता और सादगी के लिए पसंद किया जाता है।

in_pashto.name: نسيمه
in_pashto.meaning: نسيمه د هغو نومونو څخه دی چې مطلب يې نرم هوا ده
in_pashto.long_meaning: نسيمه يو عربي نوم دی چې د نرم هوا يا تازه هوا معنی لري. دا نوم د نسيم کلمې څخه اخيستل شوی دی، کوم چې د تازه او نرم هوا په معنا ده. په افغان او پښتني دود کې، دا نوم د خپلې ښکلا او سادگي لپاره کارول کېږي.

in_english.name: Nusaybah
in_english.meaning: Gentle breeze, soft wind, or delicate air
in_english.long_meaning: Nusaybah is an Arabic name derived from the root 'n-s-y-m', which means 'to blow gently'. It signifies a gentle breeze or soft wind. In Islamic tradition, this name holds spiritual significance as it relates to the soothing and calming effects of nature. Historically, Nusaybah bint al-Hajjaj was a companion of the Prophet Muhammad, adding to its importance in Islamic history. The name symbolizes serenity, peace, and a connection to nature.

data.cultural_impact: Nusaybah bint Ka'b Al-Masriyyah was an Ansari woman from Medina who participated in various battles during the early Islamic era. Her name has become synonymous with the spirit of bravery, loyalty, and resilience among Muslim women. Nusaybah is remembered for her role in the Battle of Uhud when she stood by the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) protecting him with her body as arrows rained down upon him. Her courage and determination serve as an inspiration for generations of Muslim women to strive for excellence in all aspects of their lives.
data.spiritual_significance: Nusaybah symbolizes the spiritual power and strength that lies within every Muslim, particularly women. Her brave actions during the Prophet's time reflect the importance of one's unwavering faith and commitment to the cause of Allah. Nusaybah's selflessness and devotion to the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) serve as a reminder that true salvation lies not only in believing in Allah but also in putting one's faith into action. Her name encourages us to tap into our inner courage and remain steadfast in our beliefs and actions, thus upholding the values of our faith and community.

historical_references.reference: Nusaybah bint Ka'ab was a companion of the Prophet Muhammad and is known for her bravery during the Battle of Khaybar.
Historical records show that Nusaybah bint Ka'ab is also known as Umm Ammarah or Umm Al-Farwah. The name Nusaybah carried significant weight in that era.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Nusaybah remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.
